title: A non-compliant container ship carrying 2,500 containers sank in the southern Strait of Hormuz.
text:
A non-compliant container ship carrying 2,500 containers sank in the southern Strait of Hormuz."

"🔹 A non-compliant container ship attempting to transit an unauthorized, high-risk route in the Strait of Hormuz struck a sea mine, exploded, and suffered a major fire.
